A newly created Fighter starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23 — note item 23 is actually Torches despite code comments calling it "Rations", per bug B-09).

Defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts`, `createCharacter()` (anchor `createCharacter:14`), via the `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` table (referenced in `worker/src/types/index.md`), which maps class → item IDs; items are granted around lines 59/65 of that function. Item names/IDs come from the seed data in `worker/src/db/seed.ts` (see `worker/src/db/seed.md`).
